# o11y_alert_runbook_revisions (Data Source)

Lists immutable revision metadata and content for a managed alert runbook as canonical JSON.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `runbook_id` (String)

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Maximum revisions, from 1 to 200. Defaults to 50.

### Read-Only

- `revisions_json` (String) Revision history ordered newest first.
